title: Invoisio Invoice Payment Contract Schema
description: Machine-readable schema for the invoice-payment Soroban contract. Generated from Rust types — do not edit manually. Re-generate with: make schema

Asset.description: Asset type: native XLM or a Stellar-issued token.

oneOf.title: Token
oneOf.description: Stellar-issued token identified by code and issuer.

PaymentRecord.description: On-chain snapshot of a single recorded invoice payment.

invoice_id.description: Unique invoice identifier (e.g. invoisio-abc123). Matches the native Stellar Payment memo.

payer.description: Stellar account address (G...) that sent the payment.

amount.description: Payment amount in the asset's smallest unit (stroops for XLM; 7-decimal units for USDC). Must be > 0.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) sourced from the ledger at recording time.

settlement_ref.description: SHA-256 commitment (64-char lowercase hex) of the settlement reference passed to record_payment() — not the plaintext value itself (issue #512). A caller that already holds the plaintext can dedupe/verify by hashing its own copy the same way, or by calling settlement_ref_owner() with the plaintext directly.

ContractMeta.description: Version metadata stored on-chain alongside state.

storage_schema_version.description: Storage layout version. Increment when persistent storage keys or shapes change.

AllowlistMode.description: Asset allowlist policy for this contract instance. There is no requires_token_allowlist field: every non-native asset always requires allowlisting in this contract, so a field for it would only ever report a constant, never real state. Use allowed_assets()/allowlist_count() to inspect the actual allowlist.

native_allowed.description: Whether native XLM payments are accepted.

ContractConfig.description: High-level configuration snapshot returned by config(). Single permissionless call for ops/clients.

oneOf.description: Admin Stellar account address once initialised.
Address awaiting acceptance via accept_admin() after propose_admin().
Null when no admin transfer is in flight.

paused.description: Whether the contract is currently paused (writes disabled).

PaymentHistoryPage.description: Bounded, cursor-friendly slice of payment history returned by payment_history() (admin-gated, issue #512).

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass to the next call.

has_more.description: True when more entries are available after next_cursor.

SettlementRefEntry.description: A single settlement-reference to invoice_id mapping, as recorded by record_payment() or backfilled by migration.

settlement_ref.description: SHA-256 commitment of the settlement reference — never the plaintext (issue #512).

invoice_id.description: Invoice ID that consumed this settlement reference.

SettlementRefPage.description: Bounded, cursor-friendly slice of the settlement-reference index returned by settlement_ref_history() (admin-gated, issue #512). Mirrors PaymentHistoryPage's pagination and gap-skipping conventions.

records.description: Entries returned for this page, in write order.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass to the next call.

has_more.description: True when more entries are available after next_cursor.

gaps_skipped.description: Number of index slots in this page's range that were expected to hold an entry but did not (e.g. a corrupted or partially-rebuilt index). Always 0 for a healthy index.

AllowlistEntry.description: A single allowlisted (code, issuer) pair, as recorded by allow_asset() or backfilled by migration.

AllowlistPage.description: Bounded, cursor-friendly slice of the currently-allowlisted assets returned by allowed_assets(). Mirrors PaymentHistoryPage's pagination and gap-skipping conventions, except a hole here is a normal outcome of revoke_asset(), not only a sign of corruption.

records.description: Entries returned for this page, in write (allow) order.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass to the next call.

has_more.description: True when more entries are available after next_cursor.

gaps_skipped.description: Number of log slots in this page's range that have been revoked (or, on a legacy pre-migration deployment, not yet backfilled).

InvoicePaymentRecorded.description: Emitted by record_payment(). As of issue #512 this is minimized to signal only that an invoice_id was recorded — no payer, asset, amount, or settlement_ref. A consumer that needs the full record must already know invoice_id and call get_payment(invoice_id).

schema_version.description: Event payload schema version. Bumped to 2 for issue #512's payload shrink.

AssetAllowlisted.description: Emitted by allow_asset(). Signals a token was added to the allowlist.

AssetRevoked.description: Emitted by revoke_asset(). Signals a token was removed from the allowlist.

NativeAllowChanged.description: Emitted by set_allow_native(). Signals the XLM allowance flag changed.

allowed.description: New value of the native XLM allow flag.

StorageSchemaUpgraded.description: Emitted by upgrade_storage(). Signals a storage schema version upgrade.

ContractPaused.description: Emitted by set_paused(). Signals a pause or unpause state change.

triggered_by.description: Admin address that triggered the change.

AdminTransferProposed.description: Emitted by propose_admin(). Signals step 1 of the two-step admin handoff.

new_admin.description: Address proposed to become the next admin.

timestamp.description: Ledger timestamp when the proposal was made.

AdminTransferAccepted.description: Emitted by accept_admin(). Signals step 2 of the two-step admin handoff — the role has transferred.

new_admin.description: Address that accepted and is now the contract admin.

timestamp.description: Ledger timestamp when the transfer completed.

AdminTransferCancelled.description: Emitted by cancel_admin_transfer(). Signals a pending admin handoff was revoked before acceptance.

current_admin.description: Admin that cancelled the pending handoff.

cancelled_admin.description: Address that had been proposed and is no longer in line for the role.

timestamp.description: Ledger timestamp when the cancellation occurred.

HistoryIndexRebuilt.description: Emitted by rebuild_history_index(). Signals the payment history index was successfully rebuilt.

record_count.description: Number of records in the rebuilt index.

rebuilt_at.description: Ledger timestamp when the rebuild completed.

SettlementRefsMigrated.description: Emitted during a storage upgrade when settlement references are backfilled/migrated.

conflicts_skipped.description: Number of payments whose settlement_ref was already owned by a different invoice in the index and was therefore left untouched rather than overwritten. Non-zero means a genuine pre-existing duplicate was found and needs operator investigation.

migrated_at.description: Ledger timestamp when the migration occurred.

AllowlistIndexBackfilled.description: Emitted by the V3 -> V4 storage migration after backfilling the allowlist enumeration index from payment history. discovered is not necessarily the deployment's full allowlist: an asset allowlisted but never paid with before the upgrade is not discoverable this way (Soroban has no key enumeration).

discovered.description: Number of distinct, still-allowed (code, issuer) pairs newly indexed.

migrated_at.description: Ledger timestamp when the migration occurred.

LegacyPaymentsMigrated.description: Emitted by migrate_legacy_payments() when at least one legacy Payment(invoice_id) entry was migrated to PaymentV1 and its legacy copy removed. migrated excludes ids that were already current or not found in that call.

migrated.description: Number of legacy entries actually migrated (copied to PaymentV1 and removed from the legacy key) this call.

migrated_at.description: Ledger timestamp when the migration occurred.

ContractUpgraded.description: Emitted by upgrade(). Signals the deployed WASM was swapped in place.

previous_version.description: Packed semver of the code that was running when upgrade() was called.

new_version.description: Caller-supplied packed semver of the code being deployed. Not verified on-chain against new_wasm_hash.

new_wasm_hash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte hash of the newly installed WASM.

upgraded_by.description: Admin address that triggered the upgrade.

upgraded_at.description: Ledger timestamp when the upgrade occurred.

AlreadyInitialized.description: initialize() called on an already-initialised contract.

PaymentAlreadyRecorded.description: record_payment() called with an invoice_id that was already recorded.

PaymentNotFound.description: get_payment() called for an invoice_id with no record.

InvalidAsset.description: asset_code empty, or non-XLM asset supplied without asset_issuer.

AssetNotAllowed.description: Asset not in the admin-controlled allowlist.

StorageSchemaTooNew.description: Contract code is too old for the current storage schema.

StorageSchemaTooOld.description: Storage schema is too old and requires migration.

ContractPaused.description: The contract is paused and write operations are disabled.

InvalidSettlementRef.description: settlement_ref was empty or exceeded the 128-character maximum.

NoPendingAdmin.description: accept_admin() called but no admin transfer proposal is pending.

PendingAdminExists.description: propose_admin() called while an admin transfer proposal is already pending.

InvalidProposedAdmin.description: propose_admin() called with the current admin (or other invalid address).

HistoryIndexRebuildFailed.description: rebuild_history_index() failed to rebuild the payment history index; check storage consistency.

MigrationRequired.description: rebuild_history_index() was called on a deployment whose storage schema is not yet current; run upgrade_storage() first.

HistoryIndexIncomplete.description: The payment history index is incomplete and must be rebuilt via rebuild_history_index().

SettlementRefAlreadyUsed.description: The settlement reference has already been used for a different invoice; each settlement reference must be globally unique across all payments.

MustBePausedForUpgrade.description: upgrade() was called while the contract is not paused; the contract must stay paused for the whole upgrade() -> upgrade_storage() window.

LegacyPaymentMigrationBatchTooLarge.description: migrate_legacy_payments() was called with more invoice_ids than MAX_LEGACY_MIGRATION_BATCH in one call; split the batch across multiple calls.

has_payment.description: Return true if a payment exists for invoice_id.

payment_count.description: Admin-gated (issue #512): return total recorded payment count.

pending_admin.description: Return the address proposed as next admin, if any.

propose_admin.description: Step 1 of two-step handoff: propose the next admin.

accept_admin.description: Step 2 of two-step handoff: accept the role and become admin.

cancel_admin_transfer.description: Cancel a pending admin transfer proposed via propose_admin().

allowed_assets.description: Return a bounded, cursor-paginated AllowlistPage of currently-allowlisted (code, issuer) pairs.

allowlist_count.description: Return the number of currently-allowlisted (code, issuer) pairs.

payment_history.description: Admin-gated (issue #512): return a bounded, cursor-paginated PaymentHistoryPage across all payments.

settlement_ref_owner.description: Resolve a settlement reference (plaintext) to the invoice_id that consumed it; None if unused. Hashes internally to the stored commitment (issue #512).

settlement_ref_history.description: Admin-gated (issue #512): return a bounded, cursor-paginated SettlementRefPage of the settlement-reference index in write order. Each entry's settlement_ref is a SHA-256 commitment, not plaintext.

settlement_ref_index_status.description: Admin-gated (issue #512): return (settlement_ref_count, payment_count, is_consistent) diagnostic status for the settlement-reference index.

upgrade.description: Upgrade the deployed contract WASM in place. Requires the contract to already be paused.

upgrade_storage.description: Explicitly upgrade storage schema to current version.

set_paused.description: Pause or unpause the contract. Writes rejected when paused.

is_paused.description: Return true if the contract is currently paused.

rebuild_history_index.description: Rebuild the payment history index from existing records after a corruption or incomplete migration.

migrate_legacy_payments.description: Migrate a caller-supplied, bounded batch of legacy Payment(invoice_id) keys to PaymentV1, removing each legacy entry as it migrates. Returns (migrated, already_current, not_found).

history_index_status.description: Admin-gated (issue #512): return (history_count, payment_count, is_consistent) diagnostic status for the history index.
